title: The hidden note becomes visible: confirmed by a later retry win
shows: rule_3 was written hidden at game 1. In game 9 the first attempt lost but a retry won; the Builder updated rule_3 ("Confirmed by successful retry where drawer 4 was opened before moving the object") and the log says "confirmed by a won game (now shown to the agent)". It also rewrites rule_7 to the new game's search order.
